page.overview:
What is Pallet Town?

Pallet Town is a location introduced in Generation I.

Pallet Town is a small town in the Kanto region. It is the first setting of various games in the Pokémon franchise as well as . In the anime, the hometown of the protagonist, Ash and his rival, Gary Oak, and also his mother, Delia Ketchum. Since it has a population of eight residents, Pallet Town is the smallest town in the entire Kanto region. Other characters originating from Pallet Town throughout Pokémon media include Leaf, Chase, Elaine, Trace, and Professor Oak.

The town has a local laboratory where Professor Oak studies Pokémon. Both the player and their rival each receive their first partner Pokémon here.

The other two locations are the player's house, where the player lives and begins their journey, and their rival's house, where their rival lives.
